programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: 100 years ago, land was stolen from the tribe of Ngati-Oneone in the East Coast of New Zealand. The land was taken from them to build a port, now known as, ‘Gisborne Port.’ After years of debating to give the land back and not being heard, the decedents of Rawiri Te Eketu o te Rangi have decided to march and take occupation over the land that is rightfully theirs. (R)

programme.title: Waka Huia
programme.desc: A proud son of Ngāti Manawa, war veteran Richard Dargaville, once a soldier for the New Zealand Army, he remains forever a soldier for te ao Māori.
